result:
U12 is complete. All three gates are green.

## What I did

**1. Zajednica** — The hero was rebuilt to the exact composition of the dashboard greeting hero: school background (new `.ink-dots`, the yellow counterpart of `sketch-grid` since the community hero sits on ink), lucide watermark, `eyebrow → title → yellow stroke → lead`, `p-4 sm:p-6`. The title dropped `type-hero` + `truncate` → `type-h1`, which also fixes the mid-width clipping U10 had flagged. Thread cards got one padding, a single 14/12/12 meta scale, and **two clearly separated action groups**: voting is now one control in a shared pill (up / score / down), comments sit beside it as a bordered button, share/save form a second group at a wider gap.

**2. Admin** — Status badge colours flipped per the brief (published = yellow, draft = quiet + the row's existing `ink-hatch`, archive = plain pill). The rule now lives in `lib/admin-content-tree.ts` with 6 tests so it can't silently revert. The platform-state overview was rewritten into the dashboard-window composition, reusing the zone chip from `lib/dashboard-zones.ts`. Three nav lists on the U10 rhythm.

**3. Studio** — `studio-page` moved off 8 hand-rolled type recipes onto the scale; the `PILL` constant is gone because all five buttons are now `Button`/`LinkButton`. The three hand-built grid empty states became the `EmptyState` primitive — the "no filter matches" state had been swallowing its own title. The intro panel got the same school background as the heroes.

**4. Consistency sweep** — 16 raw `rgba(244,190,48,α)` shadows across 9 alphas collapsed to `var(--yellow)`, which turns the shadow into a readable rule (yellow = highlighted, ink = ordinary). New `lib/surface-accents.test.ts` (4 tests) keeps the raw form from returning and guards `.ink-dots`. Full alignment table is in the progress file.

**5. Poruke** — Inbox header and body now share `p-4` (they were 24 vs 12, so rows never lined up with the title above them), bubbles 16/12 instead of 14/10, composer on the same padding, empty inbox through the primitive.

## Two things to look at first

- **The admin badge flip knowingly reverses a U6 decision** (U6 deliberately made draft the loudest tone). U12 asked for the opposite, so I did it — but it's a one-line change in `lib/admin-content-tree.ts`, and the test will tell you immediately.
- **On a *selected* (yellow) admin row, the yellow "Objavljeno" badge is yellow-on-yellow**, readable only through its ink border. I left the selection affordance alone rather than change behaviour; noted for your call.

**Verification:** typecheck exit 0 · lint `178 problems (1 error, 177 warnings)` — byte-identical to baseline, same pre-existing `studio-composer.tsx:1112` error · test 90 files / 1198 tests (was 89/1188) · build compiled, 74/74 pages. No Convex files touched. Nothing was seen in a browser — same caveat as U10/U11.
